description: The amount of synthesis materials obtained increases based on your Memoria ownership status. The bonus amount increases with each Memoria's release rank, and for duplicate Memoria, release ranks are combined up to rank V.
name: Memoria Bonus

description: You can challenge battles by renting characters and Memoria suitable for battle. Since the rewards don't change, try challenging with a rental party and synthesis items when you find it difficult.
name: Rental Party

description: Recipes marked with "Bonus" are featured recipes. During the feature period, there's a higher chance of creating high rarity synthesis items and getting high-level traits.
name: Recipe Pick-up

description: In "Popular Compositions," you can check popular recipes for each item. You can also rent unowned characters that appear in the top 3 positions up to 10 times per day for synthesis.
name: Popular Recipes & Rental Synthesis

description: When synthesizing, you have a chance to obtain Trait Catalysts for traits that are candidates for application. Using these Trait Catalysts increases the chance of the corresponding trait being applied to the synthesis item.
name: Trait Catalyst

description: This is a ranking content where you compete in score battles. You can obtain various rewards based on your ranking position.
name: Legend Challenge

description: You can only challenge one battle per event, and the score evaluation criteria are the same as score battles. Keep challenging to aim for a higher score!
name: Score Calculation

description: After the event period ends, you can receive rewards based on your ranking. Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail after you log in again following the end of the period.
name: Ranking Rewards

description: By giving synthesis items as presents, you can increase your intimacy level. As intimacy increases, conversation scenes may occur and you may receive gifts from characters.
name: Present

description: You can check which synthesis items can be given as presents from the "Synthesize Presents" menu.
name: Presentable Synthesis Items

description: The friendship points required to increase intimacy are determined by the type and quality of the synthesis items given as presents.
name: Earning Friendship Points

description: Characters who have awakened to 6★ can evolve their skills. By evolving skills, their effects and power will increase, becoming more powerful.
name: Skill Evolution

description: By evolving all three skills - Skill 1, Skill 2, and Burst Skill - a third ability will be unlocked.
name: Skill Evolution

description:
Skill 2 has charge indicators, and when 3 are lit, after attacking, boosts all allies' skill damage and Bolt skill damage, and also grants all allies Evasion (fixed 70% chance)!
Note: Trial battles are at max level, max awakening stage, and full Grow Board release
name: Juna "Starry Beauty" Bolt | Defender

description:
When Skill 2 has less than 3 charge indicators lit:
- Lights 1 indicator after attacking with Skill 2!
- Lights 1 indicator when self obtains a panel or takes damage!
name: Juna "Starry Beauty" Bolt | Defender

description: Before attacking with Burst Skill, removes all negative effects from all allies! After attacking, restores 15% HP to all allies and grants all allies Evasion (fixed 100% chance) until they take 1 attack!
name: Juna "Starry Beauty" Bolt | Defender

description:
- How to Fight -
- Light up charge indicators and use Skill 2 to boost all allies' skill damage!
- Use Burst Skill to grant all allies Evasion to protect them from enemy attacks!
name: Juna "Starry Beauty" Bolt | Defender

description:
With this ability, when using a battle item, grants self Force Stun until end of action! (Maximum 3 activations)
Note: Trial battles are at max level, max awakening stage, and full Grow Board release
name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

description: Additionally, when an attack target becomes stunned by using Skill 1 or Skill 2, converts or creates all panels except burst panels for all allies into Wisdom Release panels!
name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

description: Wisdom Release panels: When self obtains one, allows Burst Skill activation! When an ally obtains one, boosts their skill power and all allies' M.ATK! When an enemy obtains one, increases their magic attack damage received!
name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

description: Before attacking with Burst Skill, reduces target's Bolt resistance by 35%! After attacking, boosts target's Bolt damage received by 75%! (MAX 150%) When the target is stunned, increases the effect from boost panels for all allies!
name: Grisella "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

description:
- How to Fight -
Use battle items to stun powerful enemies with large stun gauges!
Collect burst panels to activate the Burst Skill and support your allies' attacks!
name: Grisella "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

description:
The Yumia Festival Special Cup is a limited-time battle event during the Yumia Festival period.
Your ranking changes based on total damage dealt,
and you can obtain various rewards based on your ranking position.
name: Yumia Festival Special Cup

description:
Your "Total HP depleted from enemies" will be measured within a set number of turns.
In battles at the highest difficulty, enemies will appear with infinite HP.
name: Battle Format

description:
After the event period ends, you can receive rewards based on your final ranking.
Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail sequentially
after logging in again once the period has ended.
name: Ranking Rewards

description:
Investigation Bases offer various content including story and battle content.
Using the button in the top left, you can use coins collected from Score Battles
to level up facilities and obtain rewards.
name: Investigation Base

description:
At certain facility levels, events will occur where you choose
which facility to develop. Your developed facilities will be reflected in the Investigation Base,
and you can also obtain rewards based on the number of different facility types you've developed.
name: Facility Selection

description:
By meeting various event-related conditions, you can obtain
Investigation Records. Through Investigation Records, you can view
records written by various characters.
name: Investigation Records

description:
When you reach facility level 30, you can obtain a special Investigation Record.
The Investigation Record you receive will vary depending on the distribution
of facility types you've chosen up until reaching level 30.
name: Special Investigation Record

description:
After reaching facility level 30, you can perform a facility level reset.
This resets your level and facility status, allowing you to develop different facilities
and obtain different facility level rewards based on the number of times you've reset.
name: Facility Level Reset

description:
When you reset the facility level, all developed facilities will return to their initial state.
Spent coins will not be returned. After resetting, you can develop facilities again.
Aim to develop all facilities and obtain all Investigation Records!
name: Facility Level Reset

description: Total Force Battle is a special event battle where characters who have cleared a battle once cannot be deployed in other battles within the event.
name: What is Total Force Battle?

description: Characters who become unavailable for deployment can be used again by resetting the progress of the battles they have cleared, allowing them to be deployed in event battles once more.
name: Resetting Battles

description: The background color of each square indicates the difficulty of that battle. Use this as a reference when forming your party.
name: About Difficulty

description: Clear all battles in a row simultaneously to earn Achievement Line rewards. Clear all battles simultaneously to earn Complete rewards. Try different party compositions to aim for completion!
name: About Rewards

description:
Select a character from the candidates and vote for them.
Voting tickets can be synthesized. Check the recipe in "Synthesize Voting Tickets."
name: Voting

description: You can check the party compositions other users used to clear quests. Clear party information is not displayed for certain quests like the Roman Grand Battle Tournament and Legend Challenge.
name: Clear Party

description: Characters that own multiple skins can switch between them using the button in the top left corner.
name: Switching Skins

description: Each destination has recommended characters. They change periodically, but including them in your party grants high bonuses, so be sure to bring them along.
name: Recommended Characters

description: The collection contains all the Memoria and valuables you've obtained so far. You can earn rewards based on the total number of items collected in each category.
name: Collection

description:
Each Item Challenge has designated items that can be used.
These items can more effectively boost parameters, so use them wisely to aim for a high score.
name: Special Effects

description:
This is a limited-time high-difficulty content.
You can challenge it as many times as you want without consuming Stamina or Challenge Tickets.
Starting from Floor 1, winning battles will unlock the next floor.
name: Tower Challenge

description:
Each floor may have "Floor Effects" active that provide various effects during battle.
Floor Effects differ by floor, and you can check the effects during battle.
name: Floor Effects

description: You can obtain rewards when clearing each floor for the first time.
name: Clear Rewards

description:
A battle content where the goal is to clear missions.
You can challenge battles as many times as you want without consuming Stamina or Challenge Tickets.
Change your party composition to match the missions and take on the battles.
name: Mission Battles

description:
Rewards can be obtained when you clear a mission for the first time, or when your total cleared missions reach a specified number.
Rewards can be checked in the Battle Results screen.
name: About Rewards

description:
NeoBoards are unlocked when Character Development research reaches level 40 or higher,
allowing you to further strengthen characters that meet the following conditions.
name: About NeoBoards

description:
• Level 90 or higher
• Growboard fully unlocked
• EX Board fully unlocked
name: Characters Eligible for NeoBoard

description:
Unlocking a NeoBoard requires "Grand Orbs".
After unlocking, the Growboard and EX Board are integrated into the NeoBoard,
and character development reset becomes unavailable.
name: Unlocking NeoBoards

description: Some characters that can be obtained during events have their skills locked in their initial state. Locked skills cannot be used in battle, so use items obtainable within the event to unlock them!
name: Skill Lock and Skill Release

description:
On this screen, you can select activities.
As you progress through activities, you can raise the corresponding parameters, so let's actively engage with them!
name: Activities

description:
By giving synthesis items, parameters will increase.
When parameters increase, you may be able to view conversation scenes and obtain rewards.
name: Activities

description: Items that can be given to raise parameters can be checked from "Synthesize Items" in the bottom left.
name: Target Items

description: The EXP value required for parameter increases is determined by the type and quality of the synthesis items you give.
name: Gaining EXP

description:
Characters you've welcomed can now be displayed on the home screen.
Combine your favorite backgrounds, motions, camera angles, and BGM to create your own unique home scene.
name: Character Home

description:
Characters that can be set can be viewed on the "Change Character" screen.
Also, by registering favorites, you can find characters more easily, so use this feature as needed.
name: Creation and Editing

description:
Select a created scene and press "Confirm" to switch your home.
Even after creation, you can readjust scenes using the "Edit Home" and "Change Character" buttons.
name: Home Settings

description:
Beach Flag is a turn attack dungeon where your rank is determined by the total number of turns it takes to clear.
There are no gathering points, and rewards are determined by your rank.
name: Beach Flag

description:
You can challenge Beach Flag battles with any party composition, but the runner in the dungeon will be a character related to the event.
If you have certain other characters in your party, the runner may change...?
name: Beach Flag Runner

description:
Additionally, equipment drops as a reward in Beach Flag.
Equipment traits are randomly selected from a pool of candidates, and trait levels are also randomized.
name: Equipment Drops

description:
This is a special battle where you compete with boss Antje over chip levels.
At the start of battle, both the player and Antje are dealt two chips each.
You can also obtain chips by defeating cards that appear in battle.
name: Blackjack Battle

description:
Chips are dealt at random levels from 1 to 11.
Depending on the character, advantageous chips may be dealt more easily...?
name: About Chips

description:
When your chip level reaches 21, you can deal damage to Antje.
If your chip level goes over 21, you will burst and become unable to battle.
Note: If Antje's level goes over 21, she will also burst and become unable to battle.
name: About Victory

description:
If Antje's chip level is higher than your allied character's,
Antje's attacks will deal massive damage.
Be careful not to let your chip level fall below Antje's.
name: About Victory

description:
You can pass your turn to Antje by using battle items.
Consider whether you should pass your turn while comparing your character's and Antje's chip levels.
name: Stand

description:
You win by either reaching a chip level of 21 to defeat Antje,
or by making Antje's chip level go to 22 or above to make her burst.
Try to get close to 21 while being careful not to let your chip level exceed 22.
name: Summary

description:
This is content where you challenge powerful enemies with multiple parties.
You cannot deploy characters who have already been deployed in the same battle.
You can obtain rewards each time you defeat an enemy.
name: Raid Battle

description:
This content has "Challenge Attempts."
Challenge Attempts are consumed when you clear any level within the event.
"Challenge Attempts" reset every day at 12:00.
name: Challenge Attempts

description:
Equipment items are disabled in Raid Battles.
Train your characters and Memoria before deploying them.
name: Equipment Disabled

description:
Battles in this content have a "Turn Limit."
Even if you haven't defeated the enemy, the battle will end if your party is wiped out or the remaining turns reach 0.
name: Battle Ending Without Victory

description:
You can reset the progress of the battle.
Resetting will completely reset the battle progress, including enemy HP, and character deployment status.
name: Reset
